# Lappy Tutor

> An educational platform dedicated to helping users understand device drivers and hardware architecture.

## Overview
Lappy Tutor provides clear, human-readable information about how device drivers act as software bridges between operating systems and hardware components.

## Key Sections
- **Essential Drivers**: Chipset, Graphics, Audio, Network.
- **Hardware Drivers**: Storage, USB, Bluetooth, Input Devices.
- **Peripherals**: Printers, Scanners, Webcams, Monitors.
- **Advanced**: BIOS/UEFI, Security, Power Management.

## Technical Info
- **Tech Stack**: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS.
- **Content Focus**: Driver updates, hardware compatibility, system optimization, and troubleshooting.
- **Primary URL**: https://lappytutor.co/

## Core Values
- Simplified technical concepts.
- Focus on driver awareness and education.
- Accessible troubleshooting guides.
